pages.flash_reset: Page text reset to the seeded version.
pages.flash_signin_create: You must be signed in to create a page.
pages.flash_signin_edit: You must be signed in to edit a page.
pages.sibling_nav: Previous and next page in this section
pages.draft_tooltip: Only you can see this — it is not yet published
pages.title: Pages
pages.none: No pages yet. The administrator can create the first system page — an About page is the common starting point — and any resident can start their own blog (a page of their own).
pages.section_platform_lede: Published by the platform — terms, help, privacy, and the code of conduct.
pages.form.body_hint: Optional — a folder node may have no body. Written in Markdown via the visual editor (the same one posts and announcements use).
pages.form.title_hint: The page's title — the short URL name (its address leaf) is derived from this.
pages.form.parent_top_user: Top level — this becomes a new top-level blog page
pages.form.parent_top_system: Top level — a top-level system page
pages.form.parent_hint_user: A blog page may nest under your own blog pages only (or be a top-level blog page). The system namespace is not available to blog pages.
pages.form.parent_hint_system: A system page may nest under another system page only (e.g. system/about). Blog pages cannot nest under a system page.
pages.form.public_label: Public — visible to everyone (including visitors who aren't signed in)
pages.form.public_hint: Off by default. When off, choose a scope below (all residents, a specific community, or individual grants).
pages.form.scope_hint: All residents — every signed-in resident (default). A community — only members of that community. Individual access — explicit user/group grants.
pages.form.audience_heading: Audience — who can see this page
pages.reset_confirm: Reset this page to the seeded text? Any edits you made to the body (English) and to its German / French / Danish translations will be overwritten with the seeded baseline. The rest of the page (audience, parent, etc.) is untouched.
